subject.title: feat: add disableBoundaryAwareCache compat option for prefix-matching prompt cache providers

question: Should OpenClaw expose this stable-system-prefix-only DeepSeek optimization as a public `compat.disableBoundaryAwareCache` field and automatic provider default?
rationale: The runtime behavior is well-proven, but a permanent configuration surface and automatic provider-specific upgrade change require explicit maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve after wording fix
options.body: Keep the field and DeepSeek default after the public contract is corrected to promise stable system-prefix recovery rather than direct accumulated-history reuse.

options.title: Internalize the behavior
options.body: Retain the DeepSeek-specific runtime behavior but remove the public operator-facing compatibility field.

options.title: Keep it opt-in only
options.body: Expose the compatibility field without automatically changing existing DeepSeek users until more production evidence supports the default.

recommendation.title: Approve after wording fix
recommendation.body: Keep the field and DeepSeek default after the public contract is corrected to promise stable system-prefix recovery rather than direct accumulated-history reuse.

likelyOwner.reason: The cache-boundary behavior appears to originate in his transport work, and he has the strongest recent history across the affected runtime, compatibility, and documentation paths.
